description: This file is a Python script implementing a Streamlit web app for chatting with documents using LlamaIndex. It includes functions for setting up different language models (Gemini, OpenAI, custom), processing documents to create indexes, and managing the chat interface and file uploads.

methods.name: gemini_service_context
methods.description: Sets up a Gemini language model and embedding model, then configures the global service context.

methods.name: openai_service_context
methods.description: Sets up an OpenAI language model and embedding model, then configures the global service context.

methods.name: custom_model
methods.description: Sets up a custom model with OpenAI and GooglePaLMEmbedding, then configures the global service context.

methods.name: process_documents_for_gemini
methods.description: Processes documents in a directory to create or load a Gemini-based index for querying.

methods.name: process_documents_for_openai
methods.description: Processes documents in a directory to create or load an OpenAI-based index for querying.

methods.name: process_documents_for_custom
methods.description: Processes documents in a directory to create or load a custom model-based index for querying.

methods.name: app
methods.description: Main function that runs the Streamlit app, managing file uploads, model selection, document indexing, and chat interactions.
